artboards.title: Direction D — off-white, Instrument Sans + Newsreader
Today — what Ledgerly looks like now

annotations.text:
Direction D, rebuilt light

Off-white paper (#f7f5f0) with warm greys instead of the cool slate, a deeper indigo that sits better on paper, and teal and violet replacing the bright cyan in the data colours.

Type here is option 1 from the study: Instrument Sans for the interface, Newsreader for the headline figure. Dark mode still exists, it is just no longer the default.

Sample numbers, not your real portfolio.

Which typeface?

Three treatments on the same palette and layout. Option 1 is what the screen next door uses.

1 — Instrument Sans + Newsreader. Modern sans, elegant serif on the big number only.
2 — Libre Franklin throughout. One family, no serif, most conservative.
3 — Instrument Sans + Spectral. Serif carries every figure, including the table. Most distinctive, hardest to keep tidy.

Tell me a number and I'll build the app with it.
The earlier round, kept for reference. Direction D here is the dark original you picked from.
